purpose: Make Mythical's marketing, social, support, and family-facing writing understandable without specialist knowledge. This control checks current internal examples, names the intended reader, asks for the plain meaning first, keeps sentences bounded, detects unexplained specialist language, refuses pressure and patronising language, and requires clear consequences for account, data, price, safety, privacy, AI, and permission messages. It supports children, teenagers, parents or guardians, general players, and professional readers without pretending that one score proves comprehension. Automated checks may flag a draft but may not approve or publish it. A human must still confirm accuracy, tone, age suitability, accessibility, cultural meaning, safeguarding, and whether a young reader and their parent would understand the important consequence on the first read.

referenceExamples.text: You can start playing without an account. Ask a parent or guardian if you need help opening the game.
Your progress is saved in this browser. If you clear the browser's data, your save may disappear.
The game starts without an account. Optional online features have separate age and privacy checks.
Explore six living realms with an alien companion. You can play in your browser without downloading the game.
Mythical uses AI tools to support repeatable studio work. People still approve important public, financial, safety, and product decisions.
